other_conditions: Must have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year
Must not be a member of any other welfare fund established under any law
Must not be a member of the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF), National Pension System (NPS), or Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC)
Must not be an income tax payer
Must be a registered member of the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Punjab or a family member of such a worker
Must be paying the contribution regularly
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to ₹800 for spectacles, ₹5,000 for dentures, and ₹6,000 for hearing aids, provided once per beneficiary.
